BOTDEFENSE::previous_action
Description
This iRules command returns the action taken by the previous request;
this is applicable if the current request is a follow-up to a
challenge.
Syntax
BOTDEFENSE
::
previous_action
Examples
# EXAMPLE: Log the previous action.
when
BOTDEFENSE_REQUEST
{
set
log
"botdefense previous action is"
append
log
" [BOTDEFENSE::previous_action]"
HSL
::
send
$hsl
$log
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
BOTDEFENSE_REQUEST, BOTDEFENSE_ACTION
Introduced: BIGIP-13.0.0
